ability.name: S.E.L.M.A. Aqua Breacher
ability.description: Throwable breach charge that creates line of sight or entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.

ability.name: Prisma
ability.description: Deploys holograms of Alibi that reveal an opponent's location when fired upon or interacted with.

ability.name: Garra Hook
ability.description: Grappling gun that provides a quick rappel up ledges and windows at limited distances.
ability.info: Garra Hook has a cooldown time between uses.

ability.name: Surya Gate
ability.description: Laser gate that denies entry and intel by injuring opponents and destroying devices that pass through it.

ability.name: Breaching Rounds
ability.description: Launcher with explosive rounds that destroy utility and create entryways in breakable surfaces.

ability.name: Kiba Barrier
ability.description: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and creates a bulletproof barrier that blocks entryways and line of sight.
ability.info: 1 Kiba charges over time, up to a maximum of 5.

ability.name: Shock Wire
ability.description: Electrical device that's deployed on the ground to electrify nearby metal utility.

ability.name: Rifle Shield
ability.description: Primary weapon shield attachment that provides frontal protection from headshots before breaking.

ability.name: Flash Shield
ability.description: Ballistic shield with a flash attachment that can be activated to temporarily blind Operators.
ability.info: The shield holds 4 flash charges that have a cooldown time between uses.

ability.name: Kludge Drone
ability.description: Deployable drone that either takes control of electronic devices or destroys them after a short delay.
ability.info: Each drone has 3 shots.

ability.name: Skeleton Key
ability.description: Primary weapon shotgun attachment used to create entryways or line of sight in breakable surfaces.
ability.info: Amount of ammo for the shotgun attachment.

ability.name: Tactical Crossbow
ability.description: Crossbow that fires Incendiary Bolts for area control and Micro Smoke Grenades to cover advances.
ability.info: 2 Incendiary Bolts and 2 Micro Smoke Grenades.

ability.name: Armor Panel
ability.description: Bulletproof barricades that are deployed on windows and doors to deny entry to opponents.

ability.name: Silent Step
ability.description: Move around quietly to sneak up on opponents and down them, then interrogate them to reveal opponent positions.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and fills up when ability is inactive.

ability.name: CCE Shield
ability.description: Extendable electro-shield that protects against incoming rushes by slowing opponents and injuring them over time.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and fills up when ability is inactive.

ability.name: DeathMARK Tracker
ability.description: Small probe that reveals an Opponent and Deimos to each other for a limited time.
ability.info: 1 DeathMARK charges over time, up to a maximum of 3.

ability.name: Stim Pistol
ability.description: Fires a shot that provides Doc and his team with a health boost or revive from a distance.

ability.name: Logic Bomb
ability.description: Calls Defender phones to compromise their locations, interrupt use of Observation Tools and leave them open to hacking.

ability.name: Yokai
ability.description: Drone that can hover on ceilings and manually fires sonic bursts to stun opponents and interrupt their actions.
ability.info: Each Yokai has 2 sonic burst charges that recharge after use.

ability.name: Grzmot Mine
ability.description: Concussion mine that sticks to surfaces and detonates when it detects nearby opponents to disorient them.

ability.name: F-Natt Dread Mine
ability.description: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and releases a fear-inducing gas when it detects nearby opponents.

ability.name: Adrenal Surge
ability.description: Gives Finka and her team a health boost or revive and enhances their combat capabilities.
ability.info: Adrenal Surge has a cooldown time between uses.

ability.name: RCE-Ratero Charge
ability.description: Remote-controlled charge that anchors to a surface and becomes bulletproof, then detonates.

ability.name: Welcome Mat
ability.description: Floor trap that instantly downs opponents and prevents them from moving.

ability.name: Cluster Charge
ability.description: Charge that's deployed on breakable and reinforced surfaces to injure opponents and clear devices on the other side.
ability.info: Each charge releases 4 sub-grenades.

ability.name: Flip Sight
ability.description: Magnifying scope that's equipped onto the primary weapon to outline opponents and see through smoke.

ability.name: Volcan Shield
ability.description: Incendiary bomb in a partially bulletproof casing that creates fire when destroyed.

ability.name: Trax Stingers
ability.description: Device that deploys barbed mats to slow and injure opponents that walk on them.

ability.name: Kawan Hive Launcher
ability.description: Launcher that fires a canister, releasing a swarm of bots that reveals opponents passing through it for a limited time.
ability.info: Each Kawan Hive drops a canister that releases a swarm of bots.

ability.name: X-Kairos
ability.description: Fires pellets that are manually detonated to create line of sight or entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.info: Fires 6, 4 or 2 pellets at a time.

ability.name: Gemini Replicator
ability.description: Deploys a remote-controlled hologram of lana to deceive opponents and gather intel.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and has a cooldown time before reactivating.

ability.name: Electronics Detector
ability.description: Wearable device that locates nearby electronics through objects and surfaces.

ability.name: Eyenox Model III
ability.description: Headgear that can be activated to reveal opponent footprints and scan them to ping the opponent's location.
ability.info: The headgear has limited scans available but no limit on revealing footprints.

ability.name: Active Defense System
ability.description: Deployable device that intercepts and destroys projectiles before they detonate.
ability.info: Each device holds 1 charge that recharges after use.

ability.name: "Rtila" Electroclaw
ability.description: Electrical device that sticks to surfaces and electrifies nearby metal utility.

ability.name: LV Explosive Lance
ability.description: Under-barrel projectile on primary weapon that detonates to destroy devices on either side of breakable and reinforced surfaces.

ability.name: Entry Denial Device
ability.description: Explosive trap that's attached to doorframes and window frames.

ability.name: Gu Mines
ability.description: Toxic mines that inject a compound, injuring opponents and limiting their speed
ability.info: 1 GU charges over time, up to a maximum of 9.

ability.name: EE-ONE-D
ability.description: Drone that hovers above the map and scans it for movement to reveal opponent locations.
ability.info: The drone has a cooldown time between scans.

ability.name: Evil Eye
ability.description: Bulletproof camera with a turret that manually fires lasers to injure opponents or destroy devices.
ability.info: Each Evil Eye has unlimited ammo but temporarily overheats when firing the turret for too long.

ability.name: Breaching Torch
ability.description: Blowtorch that quietly burns holes to create line of sight or entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.
ability.info: Breaching Torch has a limited number of fuel tanks, each with a gauge that empties while in use.

ability.name: Banshee Sonic Defense
ability.description: Bulletproof device that activates when opponents are near and uses sound to slow them.

ability.name: Black Mirror
ability.description: Device that's deployed on breakable or reinforced walls to create a bulletproof one-way window.

ability.name: Extendable Shield
ability.description: Shield that can be extended for full frontal protection to gather intel and provide cover for teammates.

ability.name: Pest Launcher
ability.description: Launches bots that automatically latch onto opponent drones in range to take control of them.

ability.name: Signal Disruptor
ability.description: Signal jammer that deactivates opponent electronic devices in range.

ability.name: HEL Presence Reduction
ability.description: Wipes Nøkk's image from nearby drones and Observation Tools and muffles the sound of her movement.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and fills up when ability is inactive.

ability.name: Airjab Launcher
ability.description: Primary weapon attachment that fires a device that detonates and pushes Operators to the ground.

ability.name: Remah Dash
ability.description: Dash attack that creates entryways in breakable walls, pushes opponents to the ground, and allows for faster roaming.
ability.info: Remah Dashes recharge after use.

ability.name: TALON-8 Clear Shield
ability.description: Transparent, bulletproof shield that can be carried or deployed on the ground and entryways.

ability.name: Heartbeat Sensor
ability.description: Detects the heartbeats of nearby opponents through objects and surfaces.

ability.name: BU-GI Auto-Breacher
ability.description: Deployable mini-tank that moves along a set path destroying devices and breakable surfaces in its way.

ability.name: Armor Pack
ability.description: A pack of armor plates that give teammates additional health and protect them against elimination one time.
ability.info: Armor Pack has 5 armor plates.

ability.name: R.O.U. Projector System
ability.description: Throwable device that rolls and drops projectors to create a screen that blocks line of sight.
ability.info: Each R.O.U. device drops projectors that stay active for 13 seconds.

ability.name: Tactical Breaching Hammer
ability.description: Hammer that creates entryways or line of sight in breakable surfaces and destroys bulletproof devices.

ability.name: Remote Gas Grenade
ability.description: Throwable canister that sticks to surfaces and manually detonates to release a cloud of toxic gas.

ability.name: SPEC-IO Electro-Sensor
ability.description: Device that identifies opponent electronic devices, then scans them to ping their locations.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and fills up when ability is inactive. Scan function drains the gauge completely.

ability.name: Shumikha Launcher
ability.description: Launches incendiary grenades that create a fire on detonation.
ability.info: Magazine size: 5

ability.name: EMP Grenade
ability.description: Non-damaging grenade that temporarily deactivates nearby opponent electronic devices.

ability.name: Exothermic Charge
ability.description: Explosive device that's manually detonated to create large entryways in breakable and reinforced surfaces.

ability.name: Razorbloom Shell
ability.description: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and sends out a set of sharp blades when it detects nearby opponents.

ability.name: KÓNA Station
ability.description: Device that automatically heals or revives any injured Operators in range, including opponents.
ability.info: Each K6na Station has 1 heal that recharges after use.

ability.name: Zoto Canister
ability.description: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and releases a freezing gas, deactivating devices and slowing enemies.

ability.name: Shock Drones
ability.description: Drone that manually fires lasers to clear rooms of opponent devices.
ability.info: Each drone has 3 laser charges that recharge after use.

ability.name: Black Eye
ability.description: Throwable cameras that stick to surfaces and can be used by Valkyrie and her team to gather intel.

ability.name: ERC-7
ability.description: Wipes Vigil's image from nearby drones and Observation Tools so he can't be scanned.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and fills up when ability is inactive.

ability.name: Mag-net System
ability.description: Throwable device that captures incoming grenades and projectiles and detonates them after a delay.
ability.info: 1 Mag-NET recharges over time, up to a maximum of 6.

ability.name: Glance Smart Glasses
ability.description: Eyewear that improves visibility in smoke and protects against flash blindness.
ability.info: Gauge that empties while in use and fills up when ability is inactive.

ability.name: Candela
ability.description: Device that deploys a cluster of flash charges to temporarily blind Operators.
ability.info: Each Candela releases 3 flash charges.

ability.name: ARGUS Launcher
ability.description: Launcher that deploys cameras capable of piercing into breakable and reinforced surfaces to surveil both sides.
ability.info: Each camera has 1 laser charge that recharges after use.

ability.name: KS79 Lifeline
ability.description: Launcher that fires two types of grenades to disorient opponents or create entryways in breakable surfaces.
ability.info: 2 Impact Grenades and 2 Concussion Grenades.
